t: When placed in a $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$()'s matrix slots, in combination with a $(l:mffs:projector_modules/disintegration_module)$(5)Disintegration Module$(), the $(5)Collection Module$() collects items dropped from destroyed blocks into inventories surrounding the Projector.
当$(l:mffs:machines/projector)收集模块$()与$(l:mffs:projector_modules/disintegration_module)$(5)分解模块$()共同置于$(5)力场投影仪$()的矩阵插槽中时，该模块可将被摧毁方块掉落的物品收集至投射器周围的容器内。
